title: Human-Inspired Multi-Level Reinforcement Learning

layout.note: Two large rounded regions side by side on white: a blue RbRL region on the left (about 60% of the width) and a peach Rating-induced Policy Loss region on the right. In the blue region the Environment (top-left), the RL Agent (bottom-left) and a big Segments box with Bad and Good groups (right) are joined by vertical and horizontal arrows, with a person icon above Segments. In the peach region two buffer boxes with distribution glyphs sit above the policy-loss box, and a long arrow returns from the loss across both regions to the RL Agent.

lesson: To show how a new component plugs into an existing method, draw the existing method as one tinted region and the new component as a second region of another tint, join them with the few arrows that cross the border, and keep a class colour on every item of that class.
